title: Wood Frogs Freeze Mostly Solid And Still Survive
hook: A frog can turn mostly to ice and survive.
closing: The wood frog's survival trick could reshape how we protect living tissue from cold.
question: Would you believe this frog survived?

segments.say: A wood frog survives with 65 percent of its body water frozen, far beyond most vertebrates' lethal threshold.
A wood frog survives 16 degrees below freezing, reaching cold that ordinary frogs cannot tolerate.
Wood frogs reach 68 degrees latitude, letting them inhabit winters that exclude most frog species.
